title: Sort Array By Parity
goal: Reorder the array so all even numbers appear before all odd numbers.
strategy: Partition into even and odd groups, preserving every occurrence. The groups can then be concatenated.

phasePurposes.inspect: Partition into even and odd groups, preserving every occurrence. The groups can then be concatenated.
phasePurposes.update: The output contains all the same values with evens before odds.
phasePurposes.done: The output contains all the same values with evens before odds.
